pauseReason: The system end-to-end test depends on records from the other work items and on a person running the assistant on the sandbox virtual machine.

designRisks.summary: Dataset validation, sandbox records, independent evaluation, and rule specification are outside this ticket, so the end-to-end test cannot pass until those outputs exist.
Manual virtual-machine evidence can omit fields, and discovery can register an assistant that never becomes a shopping-session hypothesis.

topPriorityItems.reason: A human-named assistant must become a sourced registry entry.
Adding an assistant must be visible to a human.
A hypothesis without a signal, observation, sources, and measurements cannot be validated.
The system test is the acceptance check from research through a submitted rule specification.
A hypothesis with no source must not enter the pipeline.
Weak sources must stop as an unresolved investigation.
The end-to-end test must not start a shopping agent.
